_doc: Gate A allow-list (SPL-2267, tests/unit/i18n-untranslated.test.mjs): a locale value identical to en.json is NOT counted as untranslated when its English value is under 'values' or its key under 'keys'. Only product/brand names, OK, key names, units, codes, paths. Every entry carries its reason.

values.tail -f: command name, a code (spec 160 file streams list, SPL-4124)

keys.feed.live_state.mock: connection state code shown as is
keys.feed.live_state.no_base: connection state code shown as is
keys.monitoring.tab.tokens: LLM term kept as English 'Tokens' in el, es, nl: agy language review SPL-2322 (a-351, msg 66006252)
keys.reporting.costs.page.tokens: the same word as monitoring.tab.tokens in every locale (the reserved reporting.tab.tokens, SPL-2351, became this page, SPL-3798)
keys.monitoring.costs.col_tokens: the same word as monitoring.tab.tokens in every locale (SPL-3565)
keys.monitoring.tokens.col_box: ro keeps 'Box' to match its 'Boxuri' tab: agy language review SPL-2322 (a-351, msg 66006252)
keys.tenant_settings.caps_col_status: nl and sv write the caps table's Status header the same as en, like their boxes.col_state: agy language review spec 147 R5 (a-619, msg 15f62b55)
keys.auth.login.hero.agent: the sign-in hero's lower-case 'agent' badge: et, nl, pl, ro, sk and sv write the word the same (their agents.kinds.agent is 'Agent', or a longer compound for the badge) (SPL-2417)
keys.feed.topic_list.filter: the topic list filter control: sk writes the word the same, 'Filter', as its feed.move.filter (claude language review W12, c-692 msg 71fe7b12, SPL-4203)
keys.reporting.costs.cloud.box: the Cloud row's box label keeps each locale's own word 'box' (its settings.keys.use, sidebar.help.boxes; es says 'equipo'): claude language review W1, c-700 msg 15167f79, SPL-4187
keys.reporting.costs.page.cloud: the Cloud cost tab: nl, ro and sk write the cloud-computing loanword 'Cloud' as in their own cloud titles, not the sky word: claude language review W4, c-700 msg 15167f79, SPL-4187
keys.reporting.tab.marketing: the loanword 'Marketing' is the standard term in es, pl, ro and sk (as tenant_settings.marketing_title already is in pl, ro, sk); spec 163 B1, SPL-4250, agy language review before land
